request: build a redstone circuit that lights a lamp with a lever
steps: mc_guide(topic='redstone') -> how parts face, working circuits
mc_status -> position 2 -60 -6

mc_build(name='lamp circuit', x=4, y=-60, z=-6, legend='L=lever[face=floor,facing=east,powered=false], W=redstone_wire, R=repeater[facing=west,delay=2], P=redstone_lamp', layers='LWRWWP', description='lever, dust and a repeater lighting a lamp, signal goes east') -> Placed 6 blocks
mc_scan(x1=4, y1=-60, z1=-6, x2=9, y2=-60, z2=-6, states=True) -> repeater[delay=2,facing=west] as planned
mc_use_block(x=4, y=-60, z=-6) -> flipped the lever, lamp on
result: Built a lever, dust, a repeater facing the incoming side and a lamp on the floor, then flipped the lever.
keywords: redstone circuit lamp lever repeater comparator piston door torch observer wire dust signal clock gate
